name: 原声SummerWanderer
lyrics:
[主歌1]

Walk the path where sunlight 降临
穿过 the golden canopy of autumn calls
Every leaf a memory drifting down
Softly touching the worn and weathered ground

[副歌]

Summer wanderer beneath the amber 天空
Following the warmth before the 寒冷 arrives
Take these moments, hold them tight
Breathe them in like 消逝 光芒

[主歌2]

Guitar strings sing of seasons passing by
Old photographs still glowing in the mind
Every chord a step on dusty road
Every note a story yet untold

[副歌]

Summer wanderer beneath the amber 天空
Following the warmth before the 寒冷 arrives
Take these moments, hold them tight
Breathe them in like 消逝 光芒

[尾声]

(Wander on, wander on...)

name: 原声WanderersTrail
lyrics:
Verse 1:
Old road stretching endlessly
Autumn leaves beneath my feet
Morning 光芒 穿过 golden trees
A path where memory and dream meet

Chorus:
Wanderers trail, we walk along
Where the wildflowers once were strong
Every step a story untold
In the quiet, our hearts are bold

Verse 2:
Distant mountains painted 湛蓝
River winding, 天空 so clear
Every turning reveals anew
The beauty that draws us near

Chorus:
Wanderers trail, we walk along
Where the wildflowers once were strong
Every step a story untold
In the quiet, our hearts are bold

name: ElectronicAfternoonRadiance

(Ooh, ooh, ooh)

Every heartbeat racing down this road,

Something magical is happening there.

The afternoon begins to shine,
Every 暗影 finds its 光芒,

Laughter echoes off the window glass,
This afternoon, we're moving too fast.

Can you feel the warmth increase,
The city humming finds its peace,
Every corner glows with gold,

Take my hand and feel the pulse,
This moment's ours, let's embrace.
This is our afternoon radiance,

This moment's ours, let's embrace.

[尾声]

Radiance...radiance...
(Ooh, ooh, ooh)

name: 慢节奏午夜之间
lyrics:
Verse 1:
The city sleeps but I am wide awake
Under neon glow my silent heart does ache
Footsteps echo on the empty road
Carrying 梦境 that never quite unload

Chorus:
之间 two midnights I found my way
In the quiet dark where lost souls stay
Every streetlight tells a story old
In this space 之间 my heart and 寒冷

Verse 2:
Windows dark, the world has closed its eyes
Only the moon watches 穿过 the skies
Solitude tastes sweet when no one sees
The peace that comes with whispered memories

Chorus:
之间 two midnights I found my way
In the quiet dark where lost souls stay
Every streetlight tells a story old
In this space 之间 my heart and 寒冷

Outro:
Slowly 消逝 into dawn's first 光芒
Just another dreamer in the 夜
